text:
Maya (PM): Ok team — planning thread for the new staged degrade: "tiered-degrade". Need runbook for rollout, telemetry gates, and Customer Ops handoff. High level: gradual opt-in cohorts (by tenant tier), metric gates (p50 latency, error-rate, quality regressions), and a hotpath override for paying customers. :wave:

Jon (Eng): sounds good. propose 4 phases: 0) shadow, 1) 5% opt-in small tenants, 2) 25% mixed, 3) global. each phase has a bake window and a rollback threshold.

Sam (SRE): add infra checks: CPU/GPU mem, tail latency P99, queue backpressure. if any infra gate trips -> auto-fallback to baseline model.

Maya (PM): exact metrics? Ava, can you suggest thresholds we can realistically observe in first 24h?

Ava (Data): baseline suggestions from historical runs: p50 latency threshold +10% over baseline, p99 +20%, errors >0.5% absolute bump triggers alert. For quality we need eval set pass-rate drop >2% as kill switch. I'll draft SQL to compute rolling windows.

Dana (Customer Ops): handoff note: for paying customers we want a manual hotpath override (CustOps can flip to baseline instantly). Also need a communication template for customers in cohort 1.

Leila (Product Ops): propose runbook steps in plain order for on-call: 1) verify metrics dashboard 2) run smoke queries 3) check failing tenant list 4) if rollforward -> increase cohort else rollback.

Jon (Eng): flag config draft (suggested):
```
flag: tiered_degrade_v1
targeting: ["optin_cohort_small", "optin_cohort_medium"]
phases:
  - name: shadow
    duration: 24h
  - name: phase_1
    fraction: 0.05
    duration: 6h
  - name: phase_2
    fraction: 0.25
    duration: 12h
  - name: global
    fraction: 1.0
gates:
  latency_p50_pct_increase: 10
  latency_p99_pct_increase: 20
  error_rate_abs_increase: 0.5
  quality_eval_drop_pct: 2
```

Maya (PM): love the draft. Couple of asks: 1) Make the shadow phase include live logging to separate bucket so we can re-run evals. 2) add a dark-launch sampling at 1% of traffic for customers in higher tiers so we get quality signal without affecting them.

Jon (Eng): can do. will add dark-sample and separate logging target. Also will wire an automatic fallback endpoint for the runtime: `/v1/fallback/trigger` so Ops can trigger without a deploy.

Sam (SRE): we should also include an autoshed rule for sudden load: if queue_length > 1000 for 5m -> reject new requests with 429 for opt-in cohort only, then escalate. that avoids cross-tenant blast radius.

Dana (Customer Ops): for communications: short template for cohort customers + incident contact + opt-out link. we'll own outreach.

Ava (Data): I'll create the monitoring view with these gates and a single metric scoreboard. Also will set up anomaly detection on trend of quality_eval_drop_pct (to catch slow regressions).

Leila (Product Ops): launch criteria checklist draft: 
- Shadow run for 24h with no quality_eval_drop > 1%
- Phase 1: <10% latency p50 increase and <0.3% error bump for 6h
- Phase 2: stable telemetry for 12h and customer ops sign-off
- Ops runbook tested in staging and fallback endpoint validated

Maya (PM): ownership matrix:
- PM: Maya -> overall go/no-go
- Eng: Jon -> flag + runtime hooks
- SRE: Sam -> infra gates and autoshed rules
- Data: Ava -> metric dashboards + anomaly alerts
- CustOps: Dana -> customer comms & hotpath overrides
- ProdOps: Leila -> runbook and postmortem template

Jon (Eng): quick question — how strict should quality gate be for premium customers in dark sample? I can route premium queries to shadow only if they opt-in.

Dana (Customer Ops): premium customers should be opt-out by default (i.e., don't include them in opt-in cohorts unless they request). Dark sample allowed at 0.5% for premium only for signal.

Maya (PM): decision: premium = opt-out, dark-sample 0.5% only. Regular tiers follow phased opt-in. We'll keep a tier mapping table.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: canary-deploy/tiered-degrade-v1 -> queued (ETA 14:00 UTC). :rocket:

Sam (SRE): before canary, let's run a chaos test in staging simulating 30% tail-latency spike and ensure fallback triggers correctly. Who owns that?

Jon (Eng): Eng will run chaos test. I'll schedule tomorrow morning.

Maya (PM): next actions: Jon -> update flag config + fallback endpoint; Ava -> monitoring dashboards; Dana -> customer template; Leila -> finalize runbook and share to #eng-oncall; Sam -> confirm autoshed integration; All -> review by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
